task.goal: Improve failed offline Chinese dictation quality using one reviewed Android SenseVoice int8 candidate while preserving all existing privacy and draft protections.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2, baseline23ede0961ff83e5637493d7eb5f6c5ecf6b84f59. Previous task is reviewed PARTIAL/REVISE, not CP2 accepted. One CP2 rework only.

Candidate route only: sherpa-onnx with SenseVoice zh-en-ja-ko-yue int8 model dated2024-07-17. Primary lead https://k2-fsa.github.io/sherpa/onnx/sense-voice/pretrained.html documents Android and approximately228MB model. Pin one compatible Android runtime release, all necessary native dependencies and model/token objects; verify exact origins/licenses/hashes/arm64 and16KB alignment and relevant memory/audio/log paths before loading. Old think approvals do not transfer. Do not acquire upstream audio samples or execute export/training scripts.

Implement a bounded memory-only adapter behind the existing voice interface. Preserve hold/release/cancel,90-second maximum, silence behavior, editor/session/revision anchors, manual title/category ownership, explicit text corrections and no automatic formal note save. Offline recognizer buffering may change but must have explicit90-second memory bounds, cleanup and late-result rejection; no disk audio. Keep a reproducible rollback to reviewed baseline.

First qualify genuine candidate loading and evaluate the exact frozen30 clips with fixture plan SHA95d97b465918f40831658cbcbc29390cc2b417be6a13adf542826c76d9db0b6b. Preserve voice/rate/references/66 name occurrences and semantic scoring. Bind regenerated memory PCM identities; explain any difference rather than silently alter fixture. Freeze decoding settings before scoring, no answer-fed grammar/hotwords, no sample selection or reruns to cherry-pick. System offline TTS memory-only generator remains authorized test stimulus, not product TTS.

If candidate passes both accuracy gates, finish product integration and genuine10x30-second release-to-full-result P95 plus20x90-second stability on isolated emulator; test cancellation/background/permission/draft and existing affected features, inspect storage/log/network observations. Record cold-load time, package/disk size and process/native memory with honest mobile limits. No physical devices required now.

If artifact/ABI/license/data path or quality/resource gate fails, stop that affected route and return exact evidence and partial changes, without switching to another runtime/model or constructing an acquisition-tool project. Do not repeat35-minute stability after known quality failure unless needed to diagnose a specific defect. This bounds failed experiments while preserving all unmet app requirements.
out_of_scope: No Vosk server model download, additional ASR routes, cloud ASR, private father data, persistent/raw audio attachments, training, product TTS, accounts, sync, payments or publishing.
No voice command mode, calendar, AI, relations or backup format expansion. No reduced accuracy/latency thresholds or claimed Xiaomi/family acceptance.
acceptance: Raw proper-name correctness at least90% of66 frozen occurrences and strict usable clips at least27/30; raw and explicit corrected results separate. Report failures honestly.

For qualifying integration:30-second release-to-full-result P95<=5seconds for10 runs;20 complete90-second runs, no silent dropped frames, no crashes/unbounded memory, all capture/decoder resources closed. Emulator evidence only.

Existing V1-V6 functionality and privacy/data boundaries remain intact; meaningful host/device regression, final build/lint and exact APK/source/model identities, clean owned Git changes. New runtime/model safety review completed before execution.

Return RESULT COMPLETE only with all task gates met; otherwise BLOCKED or PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED with implementation_status PARTIAL and exact missing condition. A failed candidate is a valid bounded report but not CP2 acceptance.
evidence_required: Task/attempt/contract identity; baseline/final commit and status; exact candidate objects and dependency review; immutable fixture/config identity;30 raw outputs and occurrence/semantic comparison; size/load/memory/performance limits; tests and commands; APK hashes; privacy observations; preserved Xiaomi/family gaps; one next recommendation then stop.
stop_conditions: Only this task and route; never self-start next checkpoint or add models. Report unknown license/ABI/runtime execution, privacy leakage or data damage before proceeding with affected action.
Do not overwrite unrelated changes. No silent platform permission/approval bypass. Stop after single deliverable for commander review.
